open_issues.impact: P5.8 (hub worker) must implement against these shapes: covered_from = checkpoint_seq, covered_through ≤ head_seq, expected_checkpoint_version = checkpoint_version, the lease token, both calls signed with the webhook secret, header X-Vaulter-Collab-Protocol: 2
open_issues.text: Protocol detail chosen (D44, detail level): the lease answer is a top-level JSON array, as the protocol section writes it, and each entry carries more than the listed fields: checkpoint_version (the hub must repeat it as expected_checkpoint_version), type, schema_version, checkpoint (base64|null), content (JSON seed when there is no checkpoint) and tail [{seq, update_id, payload}], read under the same locks as the lease. The worker has no room token, so it cannot use `load`. The response stops granting further leases once the entries carry max_state_bytes of state. `document` is the node id (string). Route name: vaulter.v1.collaboration.hub.compaction.lease. Problem: collaboration_checkpoint_conflict = 409, retryable after_refetch, receipt never; context.reason is lease | coverage | checkpoint_version.

open_issues.impact: one extra autosave revision before such restores and replaces; revision limits/prune apply as usual; documents tests stay green
open_issues.text: Documents behaviour added for C8 ('revision snapshot, then close G'): DocumentStateWriter::write, before a write that moves collab_epoch (restore, or a JSON replace of a document with Yjs state), captures the working state as an autosave revision when it has Yjs state and no checkpoint holds it yet. A restore after a drain therefore keeps every saved receipt in a revision. Applies to v1-store-written states too.

open_issues.text: Security boundary: compaction/lease and checkpoint are authenticated by the hub's body HMAC only (no room JWT), as protocol#Общее prescribes for the hub's own calls. Whoever holds vaulter-collaboration.hub.webhook_secret can therefore lease and publish a checkpoint (any binary state + projection) for documents with a pending marker or a drain request. PHP cannot verify a Yjs merge. Before this item the hub could write only with a user's room token.

PendingPurgeDrain (P5.3) drains trashed pending documents one after another, each up to 10 s.

open_issues.text: For P5.6 (managed drain): reuse CompactionLeases::requestDrain(PendingMarker) for each document of CollaborativeState::pendingDocuments() and the DrainWaiter binding (HubDrainer::drain does nothing inside a transaction). The draining flag must block append only, not compaction/lease or checkpoint, or the drain can never finish. drain.restore_deadline is also what content read/export/REST replace wait (PendingStateGuard::settled); a separate managed-drain deadline key would be P5.6's. Tests that need a hub use tests/Support/FakeHub::install() (online/offline) and Sleep::fake(syncWithCarbon: true).

summary: Compaction, checkpoint, drain, closing and prune of collaboration generations (D26 rev.3, C6–C8, C11, C12). New in collaboration: Persistence\CompactionLeases (grant: only the document's current open generation with a pending marker that reached compaction.trigger_updates 500 / trigger_bytes 1 MiB / trigger_age 600 s, or with drain_requested_at, drain requests first; a held lease is skipped until lease_ttl 60 s ends; the lease and the checkpoint+tail read happen in one transaction under CollaborativeState::lock() (L1–L3) and then the head FOR UPDATE (L4); requestDrain sets drain_requested_at in its own short transaction). Persistence\Checkpoint::publish: generation fence (409 collaboration_epoch_mismatch for a moved or retired G), lease token held and not expired, CS == C, CV == expected == the document's state_version, C ≤ H ≤ HS, otherwise 409 collaboration_checkpoint_conflict and nothing changes; on success CollaborativeState::publishCheckpoint, delete updates (doc, G, seq ≤ H) only, head := (H, new SV), lease spent, drain flag cleared only when the marker was cleared. Drain\HubDrainer implements PendingStateDrainer (does nothing inside a transaction; drain_requested_at, then Drain\DrainWaiter polls the marker outside any transaction with backoff up to drain.restore_deadline 10 s; the default BackoffDrainWaiter is bound in the registrar and a test binds a fake hub). Persistence\GenerationCloser (EventSink collaboration.generations) sets retired_at on heads of generations below the new epoch in the transaction of DocumentRestored / DocumentContentUpdated. Persistence\RetiredGenerations + vaulter:collaboration:prune (C11: retired_at < now − (hub.token_ttl + 10 s + retention.retired_generation_days 7); first retires heads of generations a document left while the module was off; re-checks under L3+L4 and never touches the current G; --dry-run) + CollaborationSchedule (schedule.collaboration_prune dailyAt:03:40). HTTP: POST v1/collaboration/hub/compaction/lease (vaulter.v1.collaboration.hub.compaction.lease) and POST v1/collaboration/hub/checkpoint (…hub.checkpoint), protocol 2 header required, authenticated by the body HMAC only (new VerifyHubSignature, CollaborationCallResolver::verifyHub), size-gated by LimitHubAppend (checkpoint variant: 4/3·max_state_bytes + request_bytes); route labels; problem code + lang en/ru; OpenAPI paths and schemas; manifest provides PendingStateDrainer and registers the command, the schedule and the sink. UpdateLog::snapshot was split into lock + public read(LockedDocumentState) for reuse by the lease (same statements). Documents: DocumentStateWriter, before a write that moves the epoch, captures a working state that has Yjs state and no checkpoint as an autosave revision (the C8 'revision snapshot': saved receipts are never left out of the history). Tests: CompactionCasTest (4, 5, 20 + CAS variants + HTTP), CompactionLeaseTest (19: triggers, drain priority, max, held/expired leases, retired/left G, no append right, auth/validation/413), ReceiptRetentionTest (6), RestorePendingTest (18, fake hub over HTTP; offline → 409 after a 10 s fake sleep), RestoreFenceTest (13), PruneGenerationsTest, CompactionRaceTest (serial+database, pgsql only, written, not run), CollaborationModuleTest updated, DocumentStateWriterTest +2. Also regenerated: surface snapshot, identities inventory + ledger (11 records, D26) + owners/cli rule, IdentitiesTest counts, baseline lists/ledger, tests/suites.json, zones.json database list, groups.php, Pest.php (Restore uses DatabaseMigrations).
